description: For each ToolCallRecord with is_llm_backed=true, a CostRecord is created with estimated cost (paid-api rate) and written to the Cost Ledger via record_cost_entry; non-LLM tool calls are skipped

preconditions.description: A task analysis completes and the trace contains LLM-backed tool calls with prompt_tokens and completion_tokens

expectedOutcome.description: Cost records are written to cost_ledger.db for each LLM-backed tool call with correct token counts and estimated cost; non-LLM calls produce no cost records
